editorialNotes: All summaries are newly written; source articles are linked, not copied in full.
For Anuell records, displayed dates must be labelled as the date of the linked blog publication, not the original newspaper issue date.
Publisher naming on the Hrachya Sarukhan post is only supported by its TV ալիք label; the author's blog itself is the directly verified publisher.
The public City Life feed returned seven interviews explicitly credited to Ani. Other contributors' interviews were excluded.

The current Anuell feed reports 141 entries but older publicly accessible 2011 interview permalinks did not appear among its returned interview records. Feed coverage is not an exhaustive historical bibliography.
Targeted national-library searches did not establish exact printed TV Ալիք issue/page citations for these interviews. Do not invent them.
